title: The reviewer scores blind
tagline: The line is set by the queue, and every score is shown
intro: The automatic reviewer that can approve pull requests for merging is no longer told where the passing line sits.

steps.say: A score at or above the line passes, a lower one flags, and a score that is missing or makes no sense is treated as an error that never merges.
do: python3 reviewer_verdict.py 7; python3 reviewer_verdict.py 6; python3 reviewer_verdict.py abc

steps.say: Every verdict comment now opens with the score and the result, so anyone can read how each pull request was judged.

outro: Because every score is now posted, the Owner can later check whether scores bunch up at the line, which was impossible before.
